coverage_exempt.reason: Original recursive child failure cannot occur: unchanged 0x4b6c50 has its sole return at 0x4b6ec6, sets EAX=1 at 0x4b6eb9 regardless of write results; induction over every terminating directory tree makes every child 0x4b6bd0 return 1.
Original serializer 0x4b6c50 has its sole return at 0x4b6ec6 and sets EAX=1 at 0x4b6eb9 independently of file-write results. The zero-return arm and its separate epilogue cannot execute.
